hook.line: One developer just handed the internet a full engineering team for free.
hook.visual: Whip-blur push into his face, then a movie-wizard clip over him with 'One DEVELOPER', a code tree with 'THE INTERNET', and an office with 'A FULL ENGINEERING TEAM'.

beats.what: Motion-blurred push-in on the creator in a beanie.
Meme cutaway of a movie wizard on top, creator below, 'One DEVELOPER' in big type.
Code-tree screenshot with 'just handed THE INTERNET' on white.
Stock office footage with 'A FULL ENGINEERING TEAM' on an orange highlight.
Zoom punch on the repo page as he says the numbers are bigger than reported.
Repo badges ('#1 Repository of the Day') on top, creator below: 68 agents, 286 skills.
Full-frame creator 'Here's how it works' pivot.
Screen recording of typing the plugin marketplace add command.
'Say "secure it"' title over a UI card, then 'IT RED-TEAMS YOUR OWN APP BEFORE HACKERS DO'.
Last cut to a dark UI board with a big '80%' word, ending mid-sentence.

why_it_works: Every one of the first 11 words gets its own picture (3 cuts in 3 s), so the claim is shown, not just said.
Hard numbers (68 agents, 286 skills, 255K stars) stacked early give proof before the how-to.
Mid-video pivot 'here's how it works' turns hype into a usable step, which drives saves and shares (2,362 shares).
Ending cut mid-sentence on 'test it' makes the loop restart seamlessly (loop 0.821).
weaknesses: 1.16 s median shots and dense screenshots leave the UI unreadable on one watch.
No call to action; the video just stops.
76% of text sits outside the safe area, so the app's buttons cover some of it.
for_robert: Steal the word-per-picture opener: give each key word of his first line its own cutaway in 3 s (Fred can be one of them), then settle on his face for the explanation.
